name: Tips Music Ltd (Tips Industries)
tagline: NSE: TIPSMUSIC | EXCLUDED - already upper-midcap (~Rs 8,590 Cr)
summary: Music rights (Production/distribution, leading Punjabi film producer) and IP monetization company. Source sheet noted Q1 revenue growth, higher content spend impacting profits, buyback considerations, and multi-bagger history.
fundamentals_narrative: An exceptional business by capital-efficiency metrics (ROE 83.2%, debt-free, strong profit CAGR), but already an upper-midcap at ~Rs 8,590 Cr - a 10x is not realistic within 2-3 years regardless of quality. The declining promoter holding trend (-10.8% over 3 years) is also worth independent monitoring, though not necessarily a red flag on its own for a company this size.
